snippet.title: Island Raiders - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4996050/Island_Raiders/

Watch the Island Raiders Steam trailer a PC Indie Title to see how this incremental base builder mixes Viking raids with a classic PSX aesthetic.

Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.
